system_prompt: Classify the visible spatial distribution of inspection defect coordinates. Describe morphology only; do not diagnose a manufacturing process.

classes.description: Defects broadly scattered across the disk without a dominant cluster, ring or line.
A dominant compact concentration near the wafer center.
A dominant annular concentration close to the wafer perimeter, spanning most angles.
A dominant narrow elongated band or line of defects at any orientation.
A dominant compact off-center concentration, without a full edge ring.

rules: The gray circumference is a wafer outline, not a defect ring. Only black dots are defects.
Ignore sparse background dots when a dominant structured pattern is present.
For this illustrative single-pattern taxonomy, use priority scratch > edge_ring > center_cluster > localized_cluster > uniform when patterns overlap.
Choose by spatial arrangement, not total point count. These categories do not indicate die bin status.
